home.title: NomNomzBot: run your stream, not your admin work
home.description: An open-source stream bot for Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and X. Moderation, commands, alerts, and overlays in one dashboard. Self-host it for free.
home.comingSoonNote: Sign-in is not open yet. You can self-host your own bot today.

hero.title: Run your stream. Skip the busywork.
hero.subtitle: NomNomzBot moderates chat, answers viewers, and fires alerts the instant they happen. It runs Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and X from one dashboard.
hero.finePrint: Free, self-hosted, open source (AGPL-3.0). No credit card, no seat limits.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.text: Build a reply once as a flow of steps. Branch on a condition, loop, catch a failure, and test the run before it goes live.
pipelines.caption: Branching flows with conditions, loops, and test runs, using 90+ template variables.

moderation.title: Moderation and spam defense
moderation.text: Layered spam defense with trust tiers and a dry-run mode. Filters, blocked terms, and an escalation ladder keep the chat clean.
moderation.caption: Layered spam defense with trust tiers, filters, and a dry-run default.

widgets.title: Overlays and widgets
widgets.text: Install first-party overlays as browser sources for OBS. Open the code editor when you want a widget of your own.
widgets.caption: A first-party overlay catalog, a widget gallery, and a code editor for your own widgets.

analytics.title: Analytics and recaps
analytics.text: Every stream gets its own numbers, with daily trends, top viewers, and a recap you can share when the stream ends.
analytics.caption: Per-stream stats, daily trends, top viewers, and a recap after each stream.

commands.title: Chat and commands
commands.text: Custom and built-in commands with cooldowns. Put a variable in any reply and the bot fills it in for each viewer.
commands.caption: Custom and built-in commands with cooldowns and 90+ template variables in every reply.

loyalty.title: Loyalty and economy
loyalty.text: Your own channel currency, wallets, a store, leaderboards, and chat games. Viewers can opt out, and so can you.
loyalty.caption: Channel currency, wallets, a store, leaderboards, and chat games.

music.title: Music and TTS
music.text: Spotify and YouTube song requests with a fair queue, and text-to-speech where each viewer can have a voice of their own.
music.caption: Song requests with a fair queue, and text-to-speech with a voice for each viewer.

platforms.title: Multi-platform connections
platforms.text: Connect your platforms and tools once. Every connection shows its status and what it can do, in one place.
platforms.caption: Every platform and tool connection, with its status, in one place.

demo.label: A look inside the dashboard
demo.sampleOf: Sample data for the made-up channel {channel}.

features.title: What the dashboard gives you
features.sampleNote: Every preview below uses a made-up sample channel and invented viewers. It shows the real dashboard pages, not a real community.
features.source: Read the source of this page

audience.line: Built for the streamer running the show and the mods keeping the chat clean.

deploy.title: Run it your way
deploy.subtitle: Self-host on your own box for free, or wait for the hosted version if you'd rather not run a server.

self.title: Self-host
self.point1: Runs on your server with one Docker Compose command, or as a single binary with no dependencies
self.point2: Every feature, with no seat limits and no paid tiers
self.point3: Open source (AGPL-3.0), so you can audit, fork, and patch it yourself

hosted.title: Hosted by NoMercy Labs
hosted.point1: No server to run: sign in and go live
hosted.point3: Viewers get one free account across every streamer on the instance

deploy.note: Only NoMercy Labs may operate NomNomzBot as a paid service for other streamers. Running your own bot stays free and unrestricted, forever.

integrations.title: Connects to what your stream already runs on

cta.title: Connect a platform. You're live in the dashboard in under a minute.
cta.body: Self-host it for free, forever. It needs nothing from NoMercy's servers.
